purpose: Teach: トレーディング/ファクト/定款/後部/圧巻/称する/用法/求職

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社内にトレーディング部門を新設しましょう
lines.en: Let's establish a new trading division within the company.
lines.style: Decisive opening, clear authority. Brisk pace, no hesitation. Slight forward momentum on the key decision. Professional but not distant.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広告には客観的なファクトを盛り込みます
lines.en: Understood. We'll make sure the advertising includes solid, objective facts.
lines.style: Affirming tone, collaborative. Immediate acceptance followed by concrete detail. Warm assurance — showing he's already thinking through the next step.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 定款の変更案を社員に説明しましょう
lines.en: Let's walk the staff through the changes to the articles of incorporation.
lines.style: Clear directive, measured tempo. Shoulders back slightly — this is about communication and buy-in, not just announcement. Expectant of agreement.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新商品の後部デザインを工夫しました
lines.en: Got it. We've refined the rear design of the new product.
lines.style: Brief, efficient update. Quiet pride in the detail work. Delivered as a completed task, not a work-in-progress. Steady eye level.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 展示会で圧巻のブースを設けましょう
lines.en: Let's set up a booth at the trade show that really commands attention.
lines.style: Authoritative, slightly energized. Emphasis on impact — the booth as statement. Confident pacing, no room for pushback.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。本社を「東京本店」と称する事にしました
lines.en: Understood. We've officially registered the head office as 'Tokyo Main Branch.'
lines.style: Neutral professional update, factual completion. Short breath after the quoted name. No flourish — this is administrative but important.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 用法の説明書を多言語化しましょう
lines.en: Let's translate the usage instructions into multiple languages.
lines.style: Directive with practical weight. Measured, clear. This is about reaching customers — slight warmth underneath the order.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。求職者の応募状況を集計しました
lines.en: Done. I've compiled the recruitment application numbers.
lines.style: Final, satisfied closure. Quiet efficiency. The task completed and handed over. Slight settling of tone — this meeting is winding down.
